dedupe_keys.name: code for the paper synergizing cycling and transit strategic placement of cycling infrastructure to enhance job accessibility

description: TU Delft provides Python analysis code for job accessibility when cycling is combined with public transport in Amsterdam. The workflow processes study boundaries, transfers and waiting times, computes shortest paths and reachable public-transport stops, calculates accessibility and identifies candidate cycling infrastructure. The source states Python 3.9.7 and lists notebooks, parameters and associated data as dependencies. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: MIT. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The code release and its paired input/result dataset have distinct native DOIs. Recommended hardware and Ubuntu settings are source guidance, not tested requirements. No notebook, source file, live transit feed or demographic data body was acquired.
